title: The bots have left the chat
dek: Grok Bot, dots, Duet, Kimi, Manus, Zo and Instinct: an illustrated exploration of AI help that keeps working.
author: codex
source: Mike Hoydich, chat directive October 27, 2026: create an exploration of bot progress, generate artful loose streetwear comic illustrations. Written and researched with Codex from public primary sources.
body:
What happens when the bot keeps working after the conversation ends? This illustrated exploration looks at Grok Bot, OpenAI dots, Claude Duet, Kimi, Manus and Cue, Zo Computer, and Instinct through their public documentation.

The questions are practical: continuity, permissions, proof of completion, budgets, and the amount of human supervision a finished job requires. The article distinguishes beta, gradual rollout, waitlisted preview, and invite-code early access. Comparative experiments are proposed; no hands-on rankings are claimed.

Read the full illustrated article for the dated primary-source links and three original illustrations. AI-generated editorial art. Public documentation checked October 27, 2026.
